sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Prostate needle biopsy gross and microscopic examination (CPT code G0416) IS ONLY REIMBURSEABLE in patients with the following conditions: – Benign neoplasm of prostate – Dysplasia of prostate – Elevated prostate specific antigen (PSA) – Enlarged or nodular prostate – Prostate cancer – Prostatitis

subsections.heading: Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans

rows.Code description: Surgical pathology, gross and microscopic examinations, for prostate needle biopsy, any method
